# T-1: Model flow findings

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Define the flow findings artifact model, validation, and persistence contract for deferred AI-derived content/alignment findings.

## Acceptance Criteria
- flow-findings.json records reference metadata and nullable non-authoritative finalDisposition without full finding detail.
- The artifact has bounded collection and read behavior.

## Implementation Notes
Use dedicated classes for artifact entries and validation. Keep the model generic and package-safe. finalDisposition is null until acceptance-review derives a mirror value from acceptance-review.json.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests under specs/293-bounded-defer-review/tests/ with // spec: R4 headers cover valid artifact persistence, invalid shape rejection, bounded size/count behavior, and source reference fields. Shared unit tests may supplement model-level edge cases.
